title: Divit
overview: This films is about a middle class boy named Shobhit who's a college student. His mother is no more since long back and hence there's no one who understands him. His father is an irritating character. Somehow he's attracted towards Aryan's life. Shobhit's friend Rohan tips him off as to what can happen while being connected to Aryan. But Shobhit doesn't seem to listen...
